98060756.s: A dimly lit pedestrian bridge near Abha Airport, offering varied options for all family members.
98060756.b: Alwatan Park is a dimly lit pedestrian bridge near Abha Airport that offers varied options for all family members. It is known for its wide green lawns, although some visitors comment on cleanliness and the need for caution at a dangerous curve at the entrance and exit. Restrooms are available for both genders, and it is a calm place to watch the sunset.

98060754.s: Close to Abha at a height overlooking much of the city, with seasonal events, walking paths and seating.
98060754.b: Sama Abha Park is close to Abha at a height overlooking much of the city, hosts seasonal events, and has walking paths and seating. It is known for its beautiful flower colors, especially in June and July, and the best time to visit is between 5 and 7 pm for stunning views.

98060751.s: Near Abha Airport, a wide, varied space with a fountain, a play area and walking tracks.
98060751.b: Abha Airport Park is near Abha Airport and is a wide, varied space with a fountain, a play area and walking tracks. It is well organized and has facilities such as restaurants, cafes, heritage seating areas and markets, making it a complete family destination for an evening out.

98060749.s: A suitable place to relax, with views overlooking wide stretches of nature. Open 24 hours.
98060749.b: Al Masqi Park is a good place to relax, with views overlooking wide stretches of nature. It is known for its unique scenery and the chance to see wild monkeys while walking around. It suits large group trips, camping and outdoor cooking, with an important reminder not to feed the monkeys, for the safety of visitors. It is open around the clock.

98060605.s: Located on one of the peaks overlooking Abha, built by the Turks to protect their soldiers, and now a viewpoint for seeing the city. Open 24 hours.
98060605.b: Shamsan Historic Castle is located on one of the peaks overlooking Abha. It was built by the Turks in the Ottoman period to protect their soldiers and is now a viewpoint for seeing the city. Although the interior is currently closed to visitors, walking around its stone walls and enjoying the outside view is still an experience worth a short visit, especially at sunset. It is open around the clock, with walking paths and seating around the site.

98060603.s: A museum with the fragrance and authenticity of the past, displaying antiques and tools used long ago, with distinctive seating overlooking the mountains.
98060603.b: Tahlal Museum carries the fragrance and authenticity of the past in its display of antiques and tools used long ago, with distinctive seating overlooking the mountains in Al Shatt village on the Al Soudah road. It is divided into a studio of heritage paintings made with local natural pigments, a museum with artifacts three centuries old, and a comfortable cafe and restaurant. Its owner, Umm Halima, is known for her generosity and warm hospitality. Open from 9:00 am to 7:30 pm, with a symbolic entrance fee.
98060603.a: Al Tali, Al Shatt Village, Al Soudah Road, Abha 62534

98060602.s: A museum that embodies an era of the fragrance of history and a distinctive destination for lovers of visual pleasure and architectural arts in a village of Bani Malik, Aseer.
98060602.b: Malik Palace Museum embodies an era of the fragrance of history and is a distinctive destination for lovers of visual pleasure and architectural arts in one of the villages of Bani Malik in the Aseer region. It sits amid stunning nature where wild monkeys sometimes appear, and visitors praise it highly despite its relative distance from the main roads. Phone: 0504782302. Open 24 hours.

98060600.s: Houses one of the enchanting views of Abha and features copper exhibits, antiques, silverware and international and local collectibles.
98060600.b: Al Raqdi Museum occupies one of the enchanting viewpoints of Abha and features copper exhibits, antiques, silverware and international and local collectibles, along with weaving tools and Aseer handicrafts. It has become a multi-story building that carries a great deal of history, with a symbolic entrance fee of 20 riyals per person. It is advisable to check opening times in advance because they sometimes change. Phone: 0504780817. Open from 4:00 pm to 11:00 pm.
98060600.a: Imam Abdulrahman ibn Faisal ibn Turki Road, Al Thirah, Abha 62521

98060599.s: A traditional house where the owner welcomes you warmly to show you its heritage corners, artifacts and old games.
98060599.b: Al Ajyal Heritage Museum is a traditional house where the owner welcomes you warmly and introduces you to its heritage corners, artifacts and old games. It is only 20 minutes from Al Soudah. It is run by an enthusiastic owner who explains the museum's details in an enjoyable, interactive way, and it has excellent reviews for its authentic experience and cheap entry ticket (10 riyals). Phone: 0545794554. Open from 8:30 am to 12:00 pm and from 2:00 pm to 9:00 pm.

98060598.s: An old house decorated with traditional Aseer engravings, holding rare exhibits of weapons, jewelry and coins.
98060598.b: Aljhali Heritage Museum is an old house decorated with traditional Aseer engravings, holding rare exhibits of weapons, jewelry and coins, along with a heritage market and a restaurant serving delicious local dishes. It holds more than 14,000 artifacts documenting the history of the region from the founding era to the modern age, and includes a family home about 100 years old that adds an authentic character to the experience. Phone: 0501736336. Open from 8:00 am to 10:00 pm.

98060597.s: A historic village more than 300 years old, with antiques, folk performances and many enjoyable activities.
98060597.b: Asabilah Palaces is a historic village more than 300 years old, with four main palaces, antiques, folk performances and many enjoyable activities. Today it has become an evening destination with shops, cafes and restaurants, sometimes with live music events, and an entrance fee of about 20 to 25 riyals per person. Phone: 0503681375. Open from 4:00 pm to 1:00 am.

98060592.s: Takes you back to the "good old days", with the old houses of Aseer villages and every detail of the village.
98060592.b: Al Masqi Heritage Village is an authentic Aseer village hundreds of years old, and is considered one of the "visible villages" mentioned in the Quran because of its great historical age. It is known for its heritage mosque, which is more than 850 years old, and its covered stone passageways, which still stand despite ongoing restoration work. It is an ideal destination for photography and history lovers, although few services are currently available at the site.

98060347.s: A modern multi-use complex with commercial and residential spaces, with distinctive golden towers and enchanting night lighting that make it a popular spot for photography.
98060347.b: Digital City is a modern multi-use complex that includes commercial and residential spaces, and is famous for its four shining golden towers, which create a stunning architectural scene, especially when you stand in the middle of them. At night the towers turn into an enchanting moving light display, and the place hosts art events such as the Noor Riyadh festival, with live music and a beautiful water fountain, although there are relatively few restaurant options nearby. Open from 6:00 am to 6:00 pm.
98060347.a: Prince Turki Bin Abdulaziz Al Awal Rd, An Nakheel, Riyadh 12382

98060335.s: The world of art and culture from a contemporary art perspective, with art exhibitions and workshops.
98060335.b: Misk Art Institute presents the world of art and culture from a contemporary art perspective, with regular art exhibitions and educational workshops for emerging and professional talents. Its spaces combine traditional and modern artistic styles in a well-coordinated way, and it has a calm, inspiring atmosphere that visitors praise, along with a cooperative and knowledgeable staff. Open from 4:00 pm to 10:00 pm (closed Friday).

98060334.s: An art gallery with rare paintings by more than one artist, available for purchase.
98060334.b: Abstract Art Gallery holds a variety of rare paintings by more than one artist, available for you to buy, and is known for showing works by Gulf, North African and Middle Eastern artists, both emerging and famous. Works are available at various budgets, and visitors praise the choice of exhibits, although the space is relatively small. Phone: 0503009936. Open from 9:30 am to 11:30 am and from 4:30 pm to 9:30 pm.
98060334.a: Northern Ring Road, Al Nakheel, Riyadh 12391

98060333.s: Founded to be a contemporary art gallery and a platform bringing together contemporary art by local and international artists.
98060333.b: Lift Art Gallery was founded to be a contemporary art gallery and a platform that brings together contemporary art by local and international artists, in Al Bujairi District in New Diriyah. Visitors can buy any piece on display, or even paint their own pictures with the tools available on site. It hosts art workshops that are announced through its social media accounts. Phone: 0552858800. Open from 11:00 am to 11:00 pm.
98060333.a: Ibn Jubair Al Tabari, New Diriyah, Diriyah 13732

98060331.s: Presents Arab fine art, art consultations and art collection building.
98060331.b: Errm Art Gallery presents Arab fine art, art consultations and art collection building, and is known for showing works by contemporary artists from across the Middle East. It is run by an owner known for his kindness and broad knowledge of art, and entry is free for everyone, which makes it an ideal destination for art lovers and for artists looking for a chance to show their work. Phone: 0500593400. Open from 10:00 am to 10:00 pm (closed Friday).

98060330.s: A multi-function contemporary gallery, and more than just an interactive art space for visitors.
98060330.b: Lakum Artspace is a multi-function contemporary gallery, and more than just an interactive art space for visitors. It hosted the exhibition "Performing Bodies," which explored the relationship of textile to loss, mourning and new birth, and it has a gift shop and a pleasant small cafe for relaxing between viewings. Phone: 920012083. Open from 10:00 am to 10:00 pm (closed Friday).
98060330.a: Al Uruba Branch Road, West Umm Al Hamam, Riyadh 12328

98060329.t: Prince Faisal Bin Fahd Arts Hall
98060329.s: Brings together varied forms of art, with each outlet of art a unique embodiment of a contemporary outlook.
98060329.b: Prince Faisal Bin Fahd Arts Hall brings together varied forms of art, with each outlet of art a unique embodiment of a contemporary outlook, inside a rehabilitated building in an old architectural style. It includes artist residency studios, a space called "Masaha" for workshops, and free weekly live painting workshops, along with a small cafe and meeting rooms. Phone: 0566740917. Open from 4:00 pm to 10:00 pm (closed Friday).
98060329.a: King Saud Road, Al Namudhajiyah, Riyadh 12731

98060327.s: A store that makes Saudi and local art available to collect and invest in, also offering a variety of artworks.
98060327.b: Ahlam Gallery is a store that makes Saudi and local art available to collect and invest in, and it also offers a variety of artworks, inside Al Mousa Center on Al Olaya Street. It hosts regular exhibitions by talented Saudi artists and has a warm, welcoming atmosphere that encourages new visitors to explore the world of art. Phone: 0559144488. Open from 9:00 am to 10:00 pm.
98060327.a: Al Mousa Center, Al Olaya Street, Riyadh 12221

98060314.s: Ideally located in the city, with many food carts and the beauty of its tree-filled nature. Open 24 hours.
98060314.b: Najd Oasis Walkway has an ideal location in the middle of the city between Al Olaya and King Fahd roads, with many food carts and the beauty of its nature, full of shady trees. It is sometimes under partial maintenance, but remains one of the cleanest and quietest walkways in Riyadh, and is carefully and continuously managed by the Riyadh Region Municipality.

98060311.s: Has wonderful architectural details and wide green spaces, along with many services and facilities. Open 24 hours.
98060311.b: Al Suwaidi Park has wonderful architectural details and wide green spaces, along with many services and facilities, and is a main destination for the annual Riyadh Season events. It hosts weekly cultural festivals with music, dance and traditional markets, with free entry, although parking and restrooms may need improvement at crowded times.

98060310.s: Its long shape makes it an ideal place for sport, with many children's play facilities and bike rental. Open 24 hours.
98060310.b: Oasis Garden has a long shape that makes it an ideal place for sport, with many children's play facilities as well as rental of bikes and wheeled toys. It is full of beautiful lighting that gives it a romantic evening atmosphere, and it is very popular for walking, running and cycling in King Salman District.

98060309.s: In the middle of a residential neighborhood, with children's games and facilities for a pleasant time with family and friends. Open 24 hours.
98060309.b: An Nafal Park sits in the middle of a residential neighborhood and has children's games and facilities and services for a pleasant time with family and friends. It has plenty of green space and clean restrooms, and is a small, comfortable destination suited to quick evening outings within the neighborhood.

98060308.s: Has wide play areas, wonderful green spaces, and facilities and services for an enjoyable outing.
98060308.b: Hizam Park has wide play areas, wonderful green spaces, and facilities and services for an enjoyable outing, along with relatively modern sports equipment. It is very busy on weekends, although some areas need more attention to grass cutting, and visitors are advised to bring everything they need because there is no grocery nearby. Phone: 0114354991. Open from 9:00 am to 6:00 pm.
98060308.a: Prince Sattam Street, Al Rafiah, Riyadh 12753
